answer_3.quote: We evaluate GPT-3.5 and GPT-4 in Section 3.4 on the oracle retrieval dataset... We use a few-shot prompt with three examples (Appendix H).

answer_4.quote: We recruited Mechanical Turk workers to annotate subclaims decomposed by Claim-Split for 700 Wikipedia claims...
answer_4.guideline: Verify two criteria: (1) Completeness: subclaims must cover all information in the claim; (2) Correctness: each subclaim must faithfully present part of the information.
